title: Brokers
description: data of: brokers.py --json. With --follow, the object imaged through the patrol and measured; otherwise new transients from the public alert broker ALeRCE that are bright enough for this rig and up in the dark here tonight. The Transient Name Server is not asked: a person checks there. Nothing moves.

follow.description: --follow: the object pointed at and imaged through the patrol.

measured.description: forced.py's row from the newest stack: mag or limit, approximately Gaia G.

unreported.description: --unreported: the bright ones on neither Rochester list, up here tonight or not.

bogus.description: Bright enough, but every detection scored bogus by ZTF's real-or-bogus score.

real_bogus.description: ZTF's real-or-bogus score on the best detection (deep where there is one): 1 real, 0 bogus.

probability.description: The broker's classifier, not a measurement.

highest.description: Degrees; null when not up here tonight (--unreported only).

reported.description: A Rochester-listed nova or supernova at the place.
